description: Generates a board/LP-grade intelligence brief for a portfolio — per-company performance, market context, and cross-portfolio opportunities — for a reporting period. For PE/VC fund reporting and quarterly reviews.

periodEnd.description: Optional ISO date for the period end. Default: the end of the last full period.

periodStart.description: Optional ISO date for the period start. Default: the start of the last full period.

portfolioId.description: The portfolio to brief. Must belong to the caller.

name: generate_portfolio_brief
